gate: Weather master (Cinematic weather, viewer local)
condition: AlchemyWeatherEnabled == false. renderWeather returns before any pass and resets rain occlusion and lightning-sheet state. The Weather trigger button is also disabled.
suppresses: All rain, splashes, wetness, ground mist, lens drops, rain cover (occlusion), lightning, lightning HQ, and the manual lightning strike.
affected_settings: AlchemyWeatherRainEnabled, AlchemyWeatherRainIntensity, AlchemyWeatherRainDensity, AlchemyWeatherSplashEnabled, AlchemyWeatherWetnessEnabled, AlchemyWeatherMistEnabled, AlchemyWeatherLensDropsEnabled, AlchemyWeatherRainOcclusion, AlchemyWeatherLightningEnabled, AlchemyWeatherLightningTrigger, AlchemyWeatherLightningQualityEnabled
affected_pages: weather_tab (weather_main, rain, splashes, wet_mist_lens, rain_cover, lightning, lightning_hq)
ui_shows_now: partial. Yes for the page header switch and the off pip on the World rail and tab (floater_director_v2.xml:11 and :91; alkitshell.cpp:317-342; alkitpage.cpp:460-473). The embedded panel greys every rain and lightning sub-control through enabled_control=AlchemyWeatherEnabled (panel_weather_settings.xml:42-46 and onward). No sentence explains that nothing renders, and the Rain checkbox stays ticked while greyed.
suggested_status: Weather is off: rain, splashes and lightning will not render. Controls stay editable.
suggested_action: Banner above the Rain card with [Turn on] bound to AlchemyWeatherEnabled (mockup master banner, mockup_src/Director.dc.html:355-361). On the Rain card header, add: Rain is on, but World weather is off.

gate: Rim master (CineRigRimEnabled); presets never enable it

suppresses: All rig rim light: per-light rim gains, sharpness, wrap and back bias, rim quality (smoothness, anti-shimmer, actors only), silhouette edge, rim wrap, rim Tron tint and rim shadow.
affected_settings: CineRigRimEnabled, CineRigRimMasterGain, CineRigRimKey*/Fill*/Rim*/Bg*, CineRigRimSilhouette*, CineRigRimWrap*, CineRigRimSmoothness, CineRigRimAntiShimmer, CineRigRimActorsOnly, CineRigRimTronMode, CineRigRimIncludeProbes
affected_pages: light_rim_tab (rig_rim, rim_quality, per_light_rim, rim_edge, rim_wrap, rim_tron, rim_diagnostics)
ui_shows_now: partial. The v2 page header has an On/Off master switch and the Light rail and tab show an off pip (floater_director_v2.xml:9 and :73; alkitpage.cpp:460-473; alkitshell.cpp:317-342). panel_dpage_light_rim.xml has no enabled_control, so the sub-controls are not greyed. The legacy panel greys them at panel_cine_light_rig.xml:1094, which the Director does not use. Preset buttons give no status.
suggested_status: Rim is off, so this preset has no visible effect. Controls stay editable.
suggested_action: [Turn on Rim] banner bound to CineRigRimEnabled. After a preset is applied, show: Preset applied. Rim is off. [Turn on]. Decide separately whether presets should auto-enable Rim (user decision).

gate: Actor-only lighting (master CineLightRigActorOnlyAll or per-light Actor only) removes projector cones and froxel contribution for that light
condition: anyActorOnly() and actorOnlyBits(light id) != 0. The effective flag is effectiveActorOnly(master, per-light). Projector shafts and froxel light injection both skip the light. The actor mask itself fails closed when invalid.
file_line: indra/newview/pipeline.cpp:21275-21279 (projector shafts); pipeline.cpp:20424-20428 (froxel); pipeline.cpp:10364-10368 (probe lights); pipeline.cpp:25445-25446 and 25122-25126 (fail-closed mask); indra/newview/alcinelightrigmodel.h:105-125; indra/newview/alcinelightrigmanager.cpp:944-946; indra/newview/alcinelightrig.cpp:2312
suppresses: Volumetric projector cones, bloom feed and fog for any Actor-only projector. The cone is simply not drawn, with no message. Froxel lighting from that light is also dropped.
affected_settings: CineLightRigActorOnlyAll, CineLightRigKeyActorOnly, CineLightRigFillActorOnly, CineLightRigRimActorOnly, CineLightRigBgActorOnly, CineLightRigCatchlightActorOnly, CineLightRigActorMaskDisable, BDMergeProjectorVolumetrics* (all cone and fog keys)
affected_pages: atmosphere_tab (projector_cones, fog_glow, dust_wind); cine_light_rig_tab (lights, rig_bounce, rig_catchlight); actors_tab (actor_mask)

suggested_status: N projector(s) are set to Actor only, so their cones and fog are hidden.
suggested_action: On projector_cones: [Show lights] (lists actorOnlyBits holders) and [Clear Actor only]. On the Rig Actor-only row: a note that projector cones depend on it.

gate: Projector volumetric master (BDMergeProjectorVolumetrics) and per-projector opt-in
condition: !BDMergeProjectorVolumetrics, or RenderShadowDetail <= 0, or the projector volumetric program is incomplete, makes renderProjectorVolumetric return. Each projector also needs isVolumetricShaftEnabled(id), a session-only opt-in on the object or its root.
file_line: indra/newview/pipeline.cpp:20896-20901; pipeline.cpp:21677-21679 (bloom feed); pipeline.cpp:21288-21300 (per-object opt-in); pipeline.cpp:22869-22870; indra/newview/skins/default/xui/en/panel_projector_shafts.xml:16; indra/newview/skins/default/xui/en/floater_lightbox_settings.xml:6353 (sl_volumetric, Lightbox per-projector check)
suppresses: All projector cones, the bloom feed of cones, and the volumetric silhouette path. Opt-in is per object and session-only.
affected_settings: BDMergeProjectorVolumetrics, BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsMultiplier, ...Density, ...Feather, ...Tint, ...TintStrength, ...FogStrength, ...FogGroundDensity, ...FogFalloff, ...FogBase, ...BloomFeed, ...MaxDistance, ...NoiseStrength, ...Dust*
affected_pages: atmosphere_tab (projector_cones, fog_glow, dust_wind); cine_light_rig_tab (easy card Edge and Vol. shaft, which map to BDMergeProjectorVolumetricsFeather and MaxDistance)

The Director Atmosphere page embeds panel_projector_shafts.xml, which carries the master checkbox 'Enable volumetric projector cones' and greys 29 controls via enabled_control=BDMergeProjectorVolumetrics. There is no text state and no per-projector opt-in indicator. Easy-card Edge and Vol. shaft show no state.
suggested_status: Projector cones are off, so Brightness, Haziness, Edge and Fog do nothing. This projector is not opted in to cones.

gate: Post-processing bypass (no_post): sky ambiance 0 on legacy gamma, build floater with RenderDisablePostProcessing, or snapshot
condition: colorCorrectWillApplyExposure returns no_post when (a) sky ReflectionProbeAmbiance == 0 and AlchemyTonemapLegacyGammaSkies is off, (b) RenderDisablePostProcessing is on and the build floater is open, or (c) gSnapshotNoPost. The no_post early returns then skip the filter stack.
file_line: indra/newview/pipeline.cpp:12810-12830; pipeline.cpp:14123-14130 (Graduated ND, Polarizer, IR, grads, Night Mask return); pipeline.cpp:13836-13846 (Night Mask); pipeline.cpp:13424-13434 (exposure and tone mix); pipeline.cpp:17719 and 18911 (Roto Ink)
suppresses: Tone mapping and exposure metering, Graduated ND, Polarizer, Infrared, soft edge, Night Mask metering, Roto Ink, and Diopter in snapshots.
affected_settings: AlchemyTonemapLegacyGammaSkies, RenderDisablePostProcessing, RenderExposure, AlchemyRenderTonemapType, RenderTonemapMix, RenderLensFilterPreset, RenderGradNDEnabled, RenderPolarizerEnabled, RenderInfraredEnabled, RenderSoftEdgeEnabled, CineLightRigNightMaskEnabled, CineOutlineEnabled
affected_pages: exposure_tab (exposure_main); image_tab (tonemap, grade); filters_tab (lens_filter); cine_light_rig_tab (night_mask); stylize_tab; diopter_tab
ui_shows_now: partial. The Lens Looks ND and Polarizer rows grey through enabled_control (panel_lens_looks.xml), but nothing shows the no_post state. Known case: Reflection Probe Ambiance 0 skies make the tone mapper appear dead (memory: tonemap-legacy-gamma-sky).
suggested_status: This sky has Reflection Probe Ambiance 0, so tone mapping and lens filters are bypassed. (Or: build tools are open with post-processing disabled.)
suggested_action: [Enable legacy-gamma tone mapping for skies] bound to AlchemyTonemapLegacyGammaSkies, and [Close build floater] for the build case. Show on exposure_tab and filters_tab.

gate: Shadows off (RenderShadowDetail = 0)
condition: RenderShadowDetail <= 0. Projector cones (pipeline:20896), sun godrays (18935), froxel light injection (20288), and projector and sun shadow generation (28732-28734) all require shadows. Spot reexpress needs > 1 (30209). gen_shadow needs > 1 (29881).
file_line: indra/newview/pipeline.cpp:18935-18937; pipeline.cpp:20288-20289; pipeline.cpp:20896-20897; pipeline.cpp:22869-22870; pipeline.cpp:22974; pipeline.cpp:28732-28734; pipeline.cpp:29881; pipeline.cpp:30209
suppresses: Sun godrays (RenderVolumetricLighting), projector cones, froxel-injected lights, all projector and sun shadows, and rig shadow policy.
affected_settings: RenderShadowDetail, RenderVolumetricLighting, BDMergeProjectorVolumetrics, BDMergeFroxelLights, BDMergeMaxSpotShadows, CineLightRigShadowMode, CineLightRigAutoShadowSlots
affected_pages: shadows_probes_tab (shadow_type, projectors); atmosphere_tab (projector_cones, sun godrays); cine_light_rig_tab (rig_aim)
ui_shows_now: no on the Director. Only Lightbox tooltips say 'Requires shadows' (floater_lightbox_settings.xml:4302 and :4462). No grey-out and no status on Atmosphere or Rig.
suggested_status: Shadows are off: projector cones, sun shafts and rig shadows will not render.
suggested_action: [Set Shadows to Sun + Projectors] on shadow_type. Add the same line to the Atmosphere volume cards.

gate: Prim glow works only when HDR is off (legacy path)
condition: RenderGlow (sRenderGlow) feeds generateGlow and combineGlow, and both run only inside the !hdr branch. With HDR on (default), Use glow, Strength, Softness, Iterations and Resolution do nothing.
suppresses: The whole Prim glow card while HDR bloom is on (the default).
affected_settings: RenderGlow, RenderGlowStrength, RenderGlowWidth, RenderGlowIterations, RenderGlowResolutionPow
ui_shows_now: no. The bloom_glow kit page (panel_dpage_look_bloom_glow.xml) has no note, and the Prim glow sliders are not greyed.
suggested_status: Prim glow is drawn only when HDR bloom is off. HDR bloom now handles glow.
suggested_action: Either hide the card while HDR is on, or add [Use legacy glow] that sets HDR off (user decision).

gate: HDR bloom toggle (RenderBloomHDR) has no reader in C++
condition: No C++ code reads RenderBloomHDR. The HDR bloom path is gated by RenderHDREnabled (pipeline.cpp:22661-22662 and 22850). Toggling the checkbox changes nothing in the pipeline.
suppresses: Nothing. The control is inert. The tooltip claims 'Off falls back to the legacy glow', which is false.
affected_settings: RenderBloomHDR (dead). Side effect: panel_exposure_hub.xml greys 4 bloom controls via enabled_control=RenderBloomHDR while bloom keeps rendering.
affected_pages: bloom_glow_tab (bloom: HDR bloom row); exposure_tab (glow_filters: bloom strength and threshold)
ui_shows_now: no. The toggle reads ON or OFF with no effect, and the Exposure hub greys controls that still work.
suggested_status: HDR bloom toggle has no effect (not wired to the pipeline).
suggested_action: Bug: wire RenderBloomHDR into the pipeline gate at pipeline.cpp:22850, or remove the row and fix the tooltip and the Exposure hub greying.

affected_settings: CineLightRigEnabled, CineRigRimEnabled, CineLightRigLiveProbeTarget
ui_shows_now: no on the Rim page. The Rim master shows On while the Rig is off, with no cross note. The Rig tab shows its own off pip.
suggested_status: Rim has no lights to act on: the Rig is off.
suggested_action: [Turn on Rig] on the Rim banner, bound to CineLightRigEnabled.

gate: Froxel Air master (BDMergeFroxelVolumetrics) and local fog volumes

suppresses: Froxel air volumetrics, local fog volumes (Director fog-volume card), froxel light injection. Depth haze is suppressed while Froxel Air is on.
affected_settings: BDMergeFroxelVolumetrics, BDMergeLocalFogVolumes, BDMergeFroxelLights, BDMergeFroxelAmbient, CineHazeEnable (suppressed by froxel)
ui_shows_now: no. Static XUI text 'Requires Froxel Air' (panel_atmospheric_volumes.xml:24-28; director_kit_index.xml:1631) never changes with state. The haze master gives no notice that froxel suppresses it.
suggested_status: Fog volumes need Froxel Air, which is off. Depth haze is paused while Froxel Air is on.
suggested_action: Make the static requirement readout dynamic. [Turn on Froxel Air] (Lightbox, floater_lightbox_settings.xml:5191).
